suggested_fix: No fix needed. The function reads pipe_ctx[i]->stream_res.tg into a local variable once, then checks that local copy for NULL before using it. A concurrent dc_state_destruct() that clears stream_res.tg can no longer cause a NULL pointer dereference between the check and the use (TOCTOU). The timing_generator object outlives this call, so the cached pointer stays valid. The loop is bounded by the num_pipes value the caller passes in.
